patterns.comment: DesignDocuments/08-lton.md: an LTON file is the inside of a table literal and nothing else -- the elements of 02 の 14.14, separated by ','. Every one of them is written in L^: the comments, the string escapes and the shapes of a number are the language's own because the same lexer reads them (08 の 3). So the whole grammar is L^'s, included rather than copied, and a change to 01 reaches LTON by itself.
